description: Base for the merge policies: digest-pinned actions, version bumps in manifests, a 3-day hold on every release that has a publish date, and security fixes merged at any time.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the schedule and the release-age hold and merge themselves, so an advisory is remediated in hours rather than at the next window.

packageRules.description: Adoptium publishes JDK releases without a date, so the hold can't apply and Renovate warns on every run; JDKs are pinned by major in setup-java, so this lets only majors through untimed, as timestamp-optional already did.
